sources.title: Thaurock/DeepSeek-R1-Distill-Qwen-32B-abliterated-GGUF · Hugging Face
sources.snippet: Why this repository? Unlike incomplete GGUF uploads, this repository provides the full 11-quantization spectrum (from high-precision F16 down to lightweight Q2_K) of the abliterated DeepSeek-R1-Distill-Qwen-32B model.

sources.snippet: We're on a journey to advance and democratize artificial intelligence through open source and open science.

sources.title: GitHub - deepseek-ai/DeepSeek-R1
sources.snippet: DeepSeek-R1-Distill-Qwen-32B outperforms OpenAI-o1-mini across various benchmarks, achieving new state-of-the-art results for dense models. NOTE: Before running DeepSeek-R1 series models locally, we kindly recommend reviewing the Usage Recommendation section.

sources.title: DeepSeek-R1-Distill-Qwen-32B · Models
sources.snippet: DeepSeek-R1 achieves performance comparable to OpenAI-o1 across math, code, and reasoning tasks. To support the research community, we have open-sourced DeepSeek-R1-Zero, DeepSeek-R1, and six dense models distilled from DeepSeek-R1 based on Llama and Qwen.

sources.snippet: The DeepSeek-R1-Distill-Qwen-32B model notably outperforms OpenAI-o1-mini across several benchmarks, establishing a new state-of-the-art for dense models of comparable size.
